senses.gloss:
Ustaralāvayantra
jy. in 38 verses in Skt. with Skt. C. an. notes in Rajasthani. by Megharatna (a. of C. on Sārasvataprakriyā), pupil of Vinayasundara of Vaṭagaccha.
On the Astrolabe, a. instrument used for the taking of altitudes of heavenly bodies, from which time an. latitude can be deduced.
Ms. in the Anup Skt. Library, Bikaner. See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XVIII. ii. p.. 119-129. [Page403-ā+ 14]
